assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: A regular pentagon A0 A1 A2 A3 A4 inscribed in a grey circle with centre O, its diagonals forming a shaded five-pointed star; the red triangle O A0 Q, with OA0 = 2 and Q the inner vertex of the star between A0 and A1, has angle 36 degrees at O, and a dashed ray from O through Q points to the midpoint of side A0A1.

difficulty_rationale: Needs the position of the crossing points of the diagonals (by symmetry and the distance from the centre to a diagonal) and an area decomposition into ten congruent triangles, with the exact values of cos 36 and cos 72 degrees.
